notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
A few minor improvements have been added and some minor BUGS fixed.

Furthermore, it was reported that the first checkpoint sometimes did not work since patch 1.1, this has now been fixed.

notes.title: Update V1.1 - Bonus level, more story in loading screens, achievements, collectables, new language, secret cheatcode, SALE
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/1742051eaabac7c4d42b216e765249c9888e5f78.png


Hello everyone,
the first big update for E06 - Anomaly is ready.



Achievements  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/6062a287ec72e3ab0a9cfc83302e3de9a1647fb0.png

You can now achieve up to 15 achievements. Seven of them for collecting green arrows which are hidden in each level or difficult to reach.

Collectables


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/ee35824f0b109639363b2ed264142263e4784427.png

Collect four of these green arrows to unlock the bonus level.

Bonus level


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/53da4515e0f246dbea93fd1d5f2840238cedf00c.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/df437b07e7b2f022a72ac7d4fe71a79234fced7f.png

The bonus level is a big puzzle which is very difficult to solve. Just right for all puzzle lovers.

The bonus level will appear in the main menu after collecting four green arrows.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/f433f40c6cf502d8105eeef4249091fd00fc644d.png

Loading screens

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/c3b86663a765544e47face1085e5181c3b62f673.jpg

Additional location information has been embedded in the loading screens.

New language: Portuguese Brasil

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35067554/ade657e5a0bed03d47cd098f54d6ec7d0f8df2e6.jpg


Thanks to Zake Kuerten, there is now a new language.

Secret cheatcode

In three level there are secret letters you have to find. 
If you enter these three letters in a row, the secret cheatcode will be unlocked, which will make your energy arrow extremely powerful.


Updates

If, despite many tests, problems with the game occur, I will of course immediately provide further updates and fixes.


SALE

From 10.08.2019 the first SALE will take place with 35% discount.


I wish you much fun playing E06 - Anomaly
